verdict.rationale: Windows' own marketing pages say it ships Snap layouts for arranging windows on screen, plus Snap groups for returning to those arrangements, and the Windows 11 Pro page lists snap layouts as a productivity feature. That directly matches snapping and tiling windows into predefined layouts. The evidence is only short marketing mentions, with no detailed documentation of the available layouts or how to trigger them. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of layout options and snap keyboard shortcuts, independent or hands-on corroboration of snap layouts in practice.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snap and tile windows into predefined layouts for multitasking

citations.quote: organize windows on your screen with Snap layouts and create Snap groups to hop back into
